earnings.title: Neurocrine Biosciences Reports Third-Quarter 2026
highlights: Total Third-Quarter 2026 Revenue Grew 41% Year-Over-Year to $1.1 Billion
Total revenues for the third-quarter 2026 were $1.1 billion, compared with $795 million in the prior-year period representing 41% year-over-year growth.

quotes.text: Our third quarter performance marks another important milestone in Neurocrine’s evolution, with net product sales exceeding $1 billion for the first time, driven by strong underlying demand across our diversified portfolio of first-in-class medicines.

outlook: INGREZZA ® (valbenazine) 2026 Net Sales Guidance Raised to $2.9 to $2.925 Billion
